params.price: the conversion rate (must fit in a uint24)

params.cached: amount of gas paid in increments of 64 when the program is cached
params.gas: amount of gas paid in increments of 256 when not the program is not cached

addChainOwner(address).notice: Add account as a chain owner

addNativeTokenOwner(address).notice: Add account as a native token owner Available in ArbOS version 41

addWasmCacheManager(address).notice: Adds account as a wasm cache manager

getAllChainOwners().notice: Retrieves the list of chain owners

getAllNativeTokenOwners().notice: Retrieves the list of native token owners Available in ArbOS version 41

isChainOwner(address).notice: See if the user is a chain owner

isNativeTokenOwner(address).notice: See if the user is a native token owner Available in ArbOS version 41

releaseL1PricerSurplusFunds(uint256).notice: Releases surplus funds from L1PricerFundsPoolAddress for use

removeChainOwner(address).notice: Remove account from the list of chain owners

removeNativeTokenOwner(address).notice: Remove account from the list of native token owners Available in ArbOS version 41

removeWasmCacheManager(address).notice: Removes account from the list of wasm cache managers

scheduleArbOSUpgrade(uint64,uint64).notice: Upgrades ArbOS to the requested version at the requested timestamp

setAmortizedCostCapBips(uint64).notice: Sets the cost amortization cap in basis points

setBrotliCompressionLevel(uint64).notice: Sets the Brotli compression level used for fast compression Available in ArbOS version 12 with default level as 1

setCalldataPriceIncrease(bool).notice: Sets the increased calldata price feature on or off (EIP-7623) Available in ArbOS version 40 with default as false

setChainConfig(string).notice: Sets serialized chain config in ArbOS state

setInkPrice(uint32).notice: Sets the amount of ink 1 gas buys

setL1BaseFeeEstimateInertia(uint64).notice: Set how slowly ArbOS updates its estimate of the L1 basefee

setL1PricePerUnit(uint256).notice: Set how much ArbOS charges per L1 gas spent on transaction data.

setL1PricingEquilibrationUnits(uint256).notice: Sets equilibration units parameter for L1 price adjustment algorithm

setL1PricingInertia(uint64).notice: Sets inertia parameter for L1 price adjustment algorithm

setL1PricingRewardRate(uint64).notice: Sets reward amount for L1 price adjustment algorithm, in wei per unit

setL1PricingRewardRecipient(address).notice: Sets reward recipient address for L1 price adjustment algorithm

setL2BaseFee(uint256).notice: Set the L2 basefee directly, bypassing the pool calculus

setL2GasBacklogTolerance(uint64).notice: Set the L2 gas backlog tolerance

setL2GasPricingInertia(uint64).notice: Set the L2 gas pricing inertia

setMaxTxGasLimit(uint64).notice: Set the maximum size a tx (and block) can be

setMinimumL2BaseFee(uint256).notice: Set the minimum basefee needed for a transaction to succeed

setNativeTokenManagementFrom(uint64).notice: Sets the NativeTokenManagementFrom time Available in ArbOS version 41

setPerBatchGasCharge(int64).notice: Sets the base charge (in L1 gas) attributed to each data batch in the calldata pricer

setSpeedLimit(uint64).notice: Set the computational speed limit for the chain

setWasmBlockCacheSize(uint16).notice: Sets the number of extra programs ArbOS caches during a given block

setWasmExpiryDays(uint16).notice: Sets the number of days after which programs deactivate

setWasmFreePages(uint16).notice: Sets the number of free wasm pages a tx gets

setWasmInitCostScalar(uint64).notice: Sets the linear adjustment made to program init costs.

setWasmKeepaliveDays(uint16).notice: Sets the age a program must be to perform a keepalive

setWasmMaxSize(uint32).notice: Sets the maximum size of the uncompressed wasm code in bytes

setWasmMaxStackDepth(uint32).notice: Sets the maximum depth (in wasm words) a wasm stack may grow

setWasmMinInitGas(uint8,uint16).notice: Sets the minimum costs to invoke a program

setWasmPageGas(uint16).notice: Sets the base cost of each additional wasm page

setWasmPageLimit(uint16).notice: Sets the maximum number of pages a wasm may allocate
